nodes.name: harness.rs
nodes.summary: Shared HTTP helpers for the E2E runner: health probe, OS/SDE test message clients, mode-switch polling, session cleanup, and console reporting (`print_result` / `print_error`). Endpoints are defined on the Tauri side under `#[cfg(debug_assertions)]` test routes; this module only performs `reqwest` calls and shapes assertions for scenario code in `os`, `sde`, and `stress`.

nodes.name: read_json_response
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that reads json response, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: check_connectivity
nodes.summary: Pre-flight connectivity check against the running Tauri app.

nodes.name: send_os_message
nodes.summary: Send a message to OS Agent via HTTP. Returns content and the list of tool names invoked during the turn.

nodes.name: send_os_message_with_opts
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that sends os message with opts, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: last_tool_call_id
nodes.summary: Return the `tool_call_id` of the most recent call with this `tool_name`, or `None` if the turn never invoked it.

nodes.name: parse_tool_calls_with_id
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that parses tool calls with id, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: parse_sde_message_response
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that parses sde message response, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: send_sde_message
nodes.summary: Send a message to SDE Agent via HTTP. Returns content and the list of tool names invoked during the turn.

nodes.name: assert_sde_tool_used
nodes.summary: Check that a specific tool was used during an SDE turn.

nodes.name: set_agent_config
nodes.summary: Patch memory-search flags on a builtin agent definition via `/agent/test/agent-config/set`. `agent_id` defaults to `builtin:sde` server-side when omitted. Returns the post-patch resolved flags so callers can verify the overlay took effect.

nodes.name: resolve_agent
nodes.summary: Resolve an agent through the same debug probe used by memory/config E2E scenarios. The response includes selected runtime fields and caller-path turn config projections.

nodes.name: reset_agent_config
nodes.summary: Drop any builtin overlay for `agent_id`, reverting it to the compiled-in definition. Best-effort — called from test teardowns where the scenario has already finished, so we swallow errors.

nodes.name: send_sde_message_with_opts
nodes.summary: Send an SDE message with extended options (memory flags, etc.).

nodes.name: check_mode_switch_pending
nodes.summary: Check if a mode switch is pending for a session.

nodes.name: send_mode_switch_response
nodes.summary: Respond to a pending mode switch.

nodes.name: cleanup_sde_session
nodes.summary: Clean up an SDE session on the running app.

nodes.name: print_result
nodes.summary: Print scenario result with pass/fail checks. Returns overall pass.

nodes.name: fetch_tool_schemas
nodes.summary: Fetch tool schemas for an active session via `/agent/test/tool-schemas/:session_id`.

nodes.name: fetch_effective_tools
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that fetches effective tools, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: fetch_todos
nodes.summary: Fetch the persisted todo list for a session. Reads the `agent_todos` SQLite rows directly via the debug endpoint, so we can assert on `manage_todo` persistence outcomes (content + `activeForm`) without relying on the LLM echoing the full list back in chat.

nodes.name: fetch_ready_todos
nodes.summary: Fetch the ready (pending + all blockers completed) todo items for a session. Calls `GET /agent/test/sde/todos/:session_id/ready` which applies the same `is_ready()` predicate as the `manage_todo list_ready` action. Used by deterministic DAG E2E scenarios to verify the filter without driving an LLM.

nodes.name: fetch_em_state
nodes.summary: Fetch the per-session `ExtractMemoriesState` snapshot. Returns `Err` if the session is not registered in `AgentAppState` (e.g., the SDE test endpoint with `no_cleanup=false` already tore it down) — callers that care about cross-turn state should use `no_cleanup=true` on all but the last turn.

nodes.name: fetch_turn_summary
nodes.summary: Fetch the last turn summary stored on the session. Returns `Ok(Some(text))` if a summary was generated, `Ok(None)` if not yet available, and `Err` if the session does not exist.

nodes.name: check_permission_pending
nodes.summary: Poll for pending permission requests on a session. Takes `base_url` directly (instead of `&Config`) so it can be called from spawned tasks without needing the full config.

nodes.name: send_permission_response
nodes.summary: Respond to a pending permission request. Takes `base_url` directly (instead of `&Config`) so it can be called from spawned tasks without needing the full config.

nodes.name: wait_for_plan_approval
nodes.summary: Poll `/agent/test/sde/plan-approval/:session_id` until a pending approval snapshot is visible, or the deadline elapses. Under the non-blocking flow the snapshot is populated by `PlanApprovalManager::mark_ready(...)` inside `create_plan` — the tool writes the plan file, marks the snapshot ready, and ends the turn early, so callers typically wait for the turn to finish first and *then* call this ...

nodes.name: send_plan_approval_response
nodes.summary: Respond to a pending plan-approval request. Non-blocking flow: this maps to a user clicking the inline Build button on the plan card. `choice` must be `"approve"` or `"approve_with_edits"`. There is no reject path — the user iterates by sending a new turn instead.

nodes.name: get_background_jobs
nodes.summary: Query the background-jobs debug endpoint for a session.

nodes.name: send_sde_message_resume
nodes.summary: Send an SDE message with the user-initiated `is_resume` hint. Equivalent to the frontend "Resume" button: triggers the deletion-based `filter_unresolved_tool_uses` cleanup path instead of the injection-based `repair_interrupted_history` crash-recovery path.

nodes.name: send_sde_message_resume_with_opts
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that sends sde message resume with opts, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: seed_orphan
nodes.summary: Seed an orphan `tool_use` tail onto an existing SDE session via `POST /agent/test/sde/seed-orphan`. The caller must have already created the session (e.g. via a prior `send_sde_message` turn).

nodes.name: fetch_transcript
nodes.summary: Fetch the persisted LLM-formatted transcript for a session.

nodes.name: reset_recovery_counters
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that resets recovery counters, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: fetch_recovery_counters
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that fetches recovery counters, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: probe_last_assistant_text
nodes.summary: Call the `POST /agent/test/last-assistant-text` debug endpoint with a synthetic messages array and return the helper's result. Returns `Ok(Some(text))` when the helper recovered text, `Ok(None)` when the helper found no non-empty assistant content, and `Err(...)` on network or server errors.

nodes.name: probe_finalize_agent_result
nodes.summary: Direct E2E probe for the `agent.rs` finalize path. Mirrors the exact logic in `agent.rs` after `execute_turn` returns: content.or_else(|| last_assistant_text(&messages)) `content` maps to `TurnResult.content`; `messages` maps to `TurnResult.messages`.

nodes.name: probe_tier1_escalation
nodes.summary: Internal helper function providing `probe tier1 escalation` support for the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: probe_plan_approval_lifecycle_order
nodes.summary: Internal helper function providing `probe plan approval lifecycle order` support for the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: status_of
nodes.summary: Internal helper function providing `status of` support for the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: probe_event_store_complete_last_running
nodes.summary: Internal helper function providing `probe event store complete last running` support for the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: seed_cancel_flag
nodes.summary: Seed `last_turn_cancelled = 1` for a session without running a turn. Mirrors what `turn_executor` does at every cancel exit point, enabling deterministic testing of the cancel-interrupt flag lifecycle.

nodes.name: fetch_cancel_flag
nodes.summary: Read `last_turn_cancelled` for `session_id` without consuming it. Returns `Ok(true)` if the marker is set (previous turn was cancelled), `Ok(false)` if it is clear (no cancel), or `Err(...)` on network error.

nodes.name: take_cancel_flag
nodes.summary: Atomically read-and-clear `last_turn_cancelled` for `session_id`. Mirrors the exact logic executed by `processor.rs` step 4b: `take_turn_cancelled` returns `true` and clears the flag. Used by E2E to exercise the cancel-interrupt injection path deterministically without running a full LLM turn.

nodes.name: print_error
nodes.summary: E2E scenario probe verifying print error against the running Tauri app's debug test endpoints.

nodes.name: workspace_add_directory
nodes.summary: Internal helper function providing `workspace add directory` support for the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: workspace_remove_directory
nodes.summary: Internal helper function providing `workspace remove directory` support for the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: workspace_list
nodes.summary: Internal helper function providing `workspace list` support for the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: prompt_environment_block
nodes.summary: Internal helper function providing `prompt environment block` support for the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: launch_seed_only
nodes.summary: Drive `POST /agent/test/session/launch-seed-only` — runs the The workspace-seeding code path in `session_launch_impl` against a real session record but with `content=""` so the LLM turn is skipped. Returns the newly-minted session id so the caller can read it back via `workspace_list_from_db`.

nodes.name: launch_seed_only_with_opts
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that launches seed only with opts, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: workspace_list_from_db
nodes.summary: Read `agent_sessions.workspace_additional_json` for a session directly from SQLite without requiring a live `SessionRuntime`. Paired with `launch_seed_only` to prove the launch-time seeding path persists what the frontend passed in.

nodes.name: EmStateSnapshot
nodes.summary: Snapshot of the per-session `ExtractMemoriesState` returned by `GET /agent/test/em-state/:session_id`. This exists to prove cross-turn persistence of the cursor / throttle / overlap guard fields. Before the em_state fix, every turn rebuilt `UnifiedMessageProcessor` with a fresh `Default` state and these fields reset to zero / None every turn; now they live on `AgentSession` and survive across t...

nodes.name: TranscriptSnapshot
nodes.summary: Response from `GET /agent/test/sde/transcript/:session_id`. Only fields actually read by resume/orphan scenarios are exposed. In particular, the per-turn deletion-based cleanup (`filter_unresolved_tool_uses`) is intentionally in-memory-only and never writes back to the DB, so `tool_call_ids` / `tool_result_ids` on the persisted transcript cannot distinguish "orphan was filtered" from "orphan wa...

nodes.name: RecoveryCounters
nodes.summary: Snapshot of the debug-only recovery-path counters exposed by `GET /agent/test/recovery/counters`. Used by resume/orphan scenarios to assert which in-memory cleanup ran (`filter_unresolved_tool_uses` vs `repair_interrupted_history`) without having to scrape the persisted transcript (neither path writes back to the DB by design).
